radius.tooltip: How round the corners are. 0 turns rounding off.

border-width.tooltip: Width of the hairline around each window. The colour is taken from the window itself - lightened on a dark window, deepened on a light one - so it stays in keeping with whatever theme and app it is drawn on. 0 clips the corners without drawing an edge.

custom-shadow.tooltip: Draws the shadow behind each window from three layers - a tight contact shadow, a middle one and a wide soft one - so it follows the rounded corners and lifts off the desktop the way a native window does. Off, the window keeps the shadow its own toolkit drew.

round-maximized.tooltip: Normally maximized windows keep square corners. Fullscreen windows are never rounded.
